action_input: processed eight-view prefix plus only current teacher-forced action slice, no earlier/later command tokens
command_mapping: each frozen command atom is encoded with the same Qwen tokenizer after the processed multimodal assistant prefix; TokenSpan start/end are final LM indices
context_slot: one constant assistant-side whitespace token after all visual tokens and before command atoms
feedback: starts at exact TokenSpan.end, never at pointer atom start or inside a multi-token atom
processor: Qwen2_5_VLProcessor.apply_chat_template content-list plus processor(text, images=real PIL RGB images)
